items.claim: Sourcing before compinit falls into _rg "$@" and errors on every shell start
items.consequence: When compdef is undefined (compinit not yet run, common with plugin managers that run compinit late), the `|| (( ! $+functions[compdef] ))` clause sends a manually sourced script into `_rg "$@"` outside a completion context. The user gets an error at every shell start and rg is not registered. The new FAQ text recommends this line in .zshrc without the ordering caveat.
items.proposed_fix: Tell FAQ readers the `source <(rg --generate complete-zsh)` line must come after `compinit`; optionally make the script distinguish 'compdef not loaded yet' from 'running without the completion system' (the harness case) so it fails quietly or defers registration.

evidence: zsh -f: `source ./rg.zsh` with no compinit -> `_rg:341: command not found: _arguments`.

items.claim: FAQ .zshrc snippet is prefixed with a '$ ' prompt, so pasting it breaks
items.consequence: The text says to add this block to $HOME/.zshrc; a pasted literal `$` is run as a command on every shell start (`command not found: $`) and the completion is never registered.
items.proposed_fix: Drop the '$ ' prefix so the block reads `source <(rg --generate complete-zsh)`; the adjacent fpath block already has no prompt.

native_payload.intent: Make `source <(rg --generate complete-zsh)` work in zsh by registering the completion via compdef when the script is sourced manually, while still running _rg when autoloaded from fpath or sourced by the test harness without compdef. FAQ documents the new option. Closes #2956.

residual_risks: A plugin manager that sources the file from inside a function literally named _rg (funcstack[1]==_rg) would run `_rg "$@"` and error; not constructed.

Autoload-from-fpath path (funcstack[1]==_rg, including ksh_autoload) and the harness no-compdef path behave as before per adversarial zsh runs; whether `compdef _rg rg` registers on a fresh system could not be confirmed distinctly because a system _rg already existed.
testing_gaps: ci/test-complete only exercises the no-compdef branch; neither the `compdef _rg rg` branch nor the funcstack[1]==_rg autoload branch is covered in CI, and no test covers source-before-compinit.

coverage.notes: Focused path: correctness read in orchestrator context plus one independent adversarial read by a local in-process adversarial reviewer (same model family, not cross-model; the cross-model peer was unavailable by run policy). No other reviewers or validators ran. No criteria files (CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md/CODING_STANDARDS.md) govern the change; no plan found; Compound Packs not applied; learnings, agent-native gaps, deployment notes not assessed.
